prompt: Add reservations to the inventory. Inventory.reserve(sku, n) holds n units of an item for an order, and Inventory.release(sku, n) gives them back; reserving more than is available, or releasing more than is reserved, raises ValueError. Inventory.available(sku) is the stock less what is reserved, and remove() may not take reserved units (ValueError). report.py's summary() must show each item's line as "<sku>: <stock> in stock, <reserved> reserved, <available> available" and list items with nothing available under a closing "Out:" line, as it does today for empty stock.
